verses.heading: 人生的虚空

verses.text: <ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>劳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">láo</rt></ruby><ruby>碌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>劳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">láo</rt></ruby><ruby>碌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>益<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yí</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rì</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>急<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby><ruby>刮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>北<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běi</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>旋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuán</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>返<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>江<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>江<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huán</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>令<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>厌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby><ruby>烦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>困<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kùn</rt></ruby><ruby>乏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fá</rt></ruby>”），<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>饱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby>；<ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby>；<ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rì</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>新<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>件<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>新<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>？<ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 传道者的经验

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>专<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuān</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>智<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>、<ruby>查<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chá</rt></ruby><ruby>究<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiū</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>练<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>劳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">láo</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>捕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>弯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wān</rt></ruby><ruby>曲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>变<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby>；<ruby>缺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quē</rt></ruby><ruby>少<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>智<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>勇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>贫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pín</rt></ruby><ruby>穷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>智<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>藐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>视<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>宁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>静<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>智<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>掌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>愚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>昧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>智<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>兵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>败<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>智<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby>；<ruby>愚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>昧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>左<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>愚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>昧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>愚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>昧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>掌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>柔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">róu</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>件<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>祸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>似<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>乎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hu</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>掌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>错<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cuò</rt></ruby><ruby>误<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>愚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>昧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>富<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>低<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dī</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>骑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>步<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>挖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wā</rt></ruby><ruby>陷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>坑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>掉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>拆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>垣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>蛇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>咬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Záo</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>挪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nuó</rt></ruby><ruby>移<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>损<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>劈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pī</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>遭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāo</rt></ruby><ruby>危<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wēi</rt></ruby><ruby>险<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>铁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tiě</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>钝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dùn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>刃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>磨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mó</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>费<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèi</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>智<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>益<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>。
